name: The R Villa Ranakah

facts.text: 3 bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, and 3 bathrooms.
A terrace with garden views, an outdoor dining area, outdoor furniture and a private entrance.
Free private parking on the premises.
Air conditioning, WiFi, a flat-screen TV and a stereo sound system.
Kitchen with stove, microwave, toaster and a mini refrigerator.
In Pererenan, about 7.8 km from Tanah Lot Temple and 8.6 km from Petitenget Temple.
